research_notes: 2026-10-01 avenues: frozen official roles, MP/ALP biographies, first-person2024 engineering interview, public professional-index/employer/leave searches, WRAS2016/17, TAFE2018/2021 and union2013 financial reports. LinkedIn direct open andTAFE2021 PDF failed; available public indexed material used. No claim based on aggregate staff FTE.

Priority: individual employment dates/hours and unpaid/parental/campaign leave for Iluka/GHD/Energetics; archived Energetics staff CV and employer histories. Do not use2024 acquisition/current ERM naming as evidence of historical owner. Woolworths early tenure and other casual work remain undated.

Reconcile WSP consultant label with first-person volunteer description; obtain AYAD placement/pay terms and precise2007–08 dates. World Bank host and government funding do not settle employment/control. Resolve shared title boundary years and concurrent governance without adding overlaps.

Identify all six reported boards and their full terms; WRAS secretary startsFebruary2017, TAFE attested2018/2021 does not prove exact start or uninterrupted tenure. Union national/state roles and Climate Reality presentations remain excluded. Study/guild/postgraduation sequence and all breaks need evidence; spouse part-time work is not her hours.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: official APH qualifications/community section, Curtin 2001 annual-report council index, South Metropolitan TAFE 2019/2020 report searches, public professional-profile index and 28 November 2022 childcare speech. Added distinct governance/study evidence and return-to-work caveat.

Curtin report PDF returned (403) Forbidden; indexed council name and adjacent date retained with uncertain heading rather than inventing start/end. South Metropolitan TAFE 2020 PDF open returned Internal Error; existing 2018/2021 evidence retained. 2012 West Australian engineering feature PDF has no extractable text; remains a later manual-review lead. Source errors do not block the national queue.

Public LinkedIn index displays a shared item about maternity leave; sharing alone is insufficient attribution of the underlying first-person statement. No individual leave date or employment fraction assigned. Energetics full-time/leave searches also found another employee tagging Mascarenhas; that employee's leave is not hers.

Next leads: obtain readable Curtin council heading/appointment record and 2012 engineering feature; archived Energetics staff CV/individual work arrangements and AYAD placement terms remain needed. APH board membership from 2016 and secretary from 2017 are separate capacities; do not count twice.
